title: Pure DoomZ
summary: DoomZ cards plus the Medius the Pure package that fetches Power Patron DoomZ, with generic staples. The page's combo lines add Ars Magna, other Power Patrons, Therion and Springans, so they use cards this list leaves out. Amalthe searches the DoomZ monsters, Raiders and Change destroy your own DoomZ cards for value, and Power Patron DoomZ turns any monster into the matching DoomZ Xyz. Power Patron DoomZ and Raiders lock you into Xyz Monsters, so the generic Extra Deck is Rank 4 first.

allow.Medius the Pure: Summoned, it adds or summons Power Patron DoomZ from the Deck.
allow.Theorealized Medius: Newest Medius support: comes in off Power Patron DoomZ and becomes DoomZ Break - Diactorus when a monster is banished.
allow.Theorealize Past Lull: With a DoomZ card out, summons Medius the Pure from the hand or Deck.
allow.Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction: Rank 10 named by Power Patron DoomZ and Jupredo.

main: DoomZ V Five - Amalthe
Summoned or destroyed by an effect: searches another DoomZ monster. Equipped, becomes a Rank 4 WIND Machine Xyz.
DoomZ VII Seven - Elara
Summoned or destroyed by an effect: Sets a DoomZ Spell/Trap from the Deck.
DoomZ XII Zero - Drastea
Destroys a DoomZ card you control to summon itself and equip an Equip Spell from the Deck; equipped, becomes a Rank 8 Xyz.
Power Patron DoomZ
Turns another Effect Monster into the DoomZ Xyz of matching Rank and equips itself to it; destroyed, searches a DoomZ card. Xyz-only Extra Deck while it's out.
Medius the Pure
Summoned: adds or summons Power Patron DoomZ; revives itself from the GY.
Jupredo the Shademachine Power Patron
Counts as DoomZ: banishes the top three cards to bring out Jupiter as an Xyz Summon; Scale 1 destroys itself and a DoomZ to destroy a card.
Theorealized Medius
Newest support. Special Summons itself while a Power Patron card is out and searches a Theorealize card; when a monster is banished, becomes DoomZ Break - Diactorus.
DoomZ Raiders
Destroys another DoomZ card to add or summon a DoomZ monster from the Deck; destroyed, destroys a monster.
DoomZ Change
Destroys a DoomZ card from the hand, Deck or field; destroyed itself, gets a DoomZ card back and summons a DoomZ.
DoomZ Command "D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G."
Equip Spell that makes a DoomZ untargetable and lets it destroy your own cards for value.
DoomZ Command "A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A."
Equip Spell: survives a battle, and destroys its holder to summon another DoomZ.
Theorealize Past Lull
With a DoomZ card out, summons Medius the Pure and the opponent can't respond.
DoomZ Destruction
Equips to a DoomZ Xyz and stops the opponent adding cards from the Deck; destroyed, equips a DoomZ from the Deck.
extra: Rank 4: destroys a DoomZ card, then a monster; destroyed with DoomZ or Medius material, fetches an Equip Spell.
Rank 8: equips a monster on summon, and negates monster effects on the field or in the GY.
Rank 5, also on top of a DoomZ Xyz: searches a DoomZ Spell/Trap and destroys a card.
Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction
Rank 10: re-equips Equip Spells from the GY and gains 3000 ATK with Xyz material.
